summary: Immuron Ltd furnished a Form 6-K attaching its ASX announcement titled 'Appendix 4G and Corporate Governance Statement,' a routine annual corporate-governance disclosure for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026, lodged with the Australian Securities Exchange on 24 September 2026 and signed by Company Secretary Olga Smejkalova. The filing maps to a US annual-meeting/governance disclosure equivalent, confirming the board approved the statement as current at 24 September 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanic is present; no risk-arb angle applies.
